content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Dharwad Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Dharwad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026 is 15 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Training and Placement Officer and Placement Executive posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by IIT Dharwad for the positions of Training and Placement Officer (TPO) and Placement Executive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: For the TPO post, a Master's Degree is required, with a Bachelor's degree considered only for exceptional candidates. For Placement Executive, a Master's or Bachelor's degree from a reputed institute is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Training and Placement Officer ranges from ₹ 60,000/- to ₹ 1,20,000/-, and for the Placement Executive, it ranges from ₹ 30,000/- to ₹ 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is ₹ 200. Payment is to be made online.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill Test, Interview, and potentially any other mode decided by the Institute or Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Karnataka, but it is advisable to check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria regarding domicile.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an age limit for the TPO and Placement Executive posts?
faq.answer: Specific age limits are not detailed here, but age relaxation is applicable for exceptional cases for the TPO post. Please refer to the official notification for precise details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026 must be submitted through the online mode only.
